En tant qu’artiste d’effets spéciaux à Ubisoft Montréal, vous concevrez, intégrerez et optimiserez des effets en temps réel pour un jeu compétitif d’arène de bataille multijoueur en ligne (MOBA). Votre travail portera principalement sur les effets liés au champ de bataille et à la jouabilité. Ces effets aideront les personnes qui jouent à comprendre rapidement les actions, les menaces, les résultats et les priorités pendant les combats.
 Vous combinerez votre jugement artistique et votre expertise technique d’Unreal Engine pour créer des effets expressifs, lisibles et performants, dans le respect de la direction artistique. Vous collaborerez avec les équipes de conception de jeu, de programmation, d’animation, de réalisation et d’art pour soutenir l’identité visuelle du jeu et la clarté de l’expérience.
 Ce que vous ferez 
 Créer et intégrer des effets spéciaux en temps réel dans Unreal Engine , à l’aide de Niagara, des matériaux, des instances de matériaux, des nuanceurs, des textures, des maillages et des Blueprints, selon les besoins
 Concevoir des effets qui communiquent clairement les capacités, attaques, impacts, zones d’effet, changements de statut, objectifs et dangers , ainsi que les autres états de jeu
 Assurer la lisibilité de la jouabilité, la hiérarchie visuelle, la synchronisation, l’anticipation et l’impact des effets pour faciliter la prise de décision, sans surcharger les combats à grande échelle ni les capacités qui se chevauchent
 Collaborer avec l’équipe de conception de jeu pour traduire les intentions et les mécaniques de jeu en retours visuels clairs
 Collaborer avec les équipes de programmation et d’art technique pour évaluer les besoins techniques, améliorer les chaînes de production, résoudre les problèmes d’intégration et soutenir le développement des outils d’effets spéciaux
 Travailler avec les équipes d’ animation, de réalisation, d’art des personnages, d’art des environnements, d’interface utilisateur et d’audio pour créer des retours cohérents pour les personnes qui jouent
 Intégrer, déboguer, mesurer les performances et optimiser les effets pour respecter les contraintes de performance en temps réel, de mémoire, d’adaptation aux capacités matérielles et des différentes plateformes 
 Améliorer les effets selon les séances de test de jeu , les données de télémétrie disponibles, la direction artistique, les priorités de production et les commentaires des équipes multidisciplinaires
 Maintenir la qualité et la cohérence des effets grâce à la documentation, aux conventions de nomenclature, aux systèmes réutilisables et aux normes de production établies
 Participer aux revues pour repérer les risques liés au périmètre de production, à la lisibilité, à la performance, aux dépendances et au travail à reprendre
Ce que vous apportez à l'équipe 
 Une expérience professionnelle pertinente en effets spéciaux temps réel , en développement de jeux ou dans une discipline connexe, ainsi qu’une excellente maîtrise d’Unreal Engine en production et de la création d’effets liés à la jouabilité
 Une expérience pratique de Niagara, des nuanceurs, des textures, des maillages et des chaînes de rendu en temps réel , ainsi qu’une compréhension des outils et chaînes de production en deux et trois dimensions utilisés pour créer les ressources nécessaires aux effets
 Une compréhension approfondie de la lisibilité de la jouabilité, des retours visuels, de la synchronisation, de l’anticipation et de la hiérarchie visuelle , ainsi que des fondamentaux artistiques : composition, couleur, éclairage, mouvement, langage des formes, proportions et contraste
 Une capacité à créer des effets expressifs dans les limites de temps de rendu par image, de mémoire, de rendus superposés des mêmes pixels, de transparence et d’adaptation aux capacités matérielles , et à diagnostiquer les problèmes de ressources, de matériaux, de particules, de Blueprints, d’intégration et de comportement en temps réel
 Une capacité à accueillir les commentaires, à améliorer votre travail, à communiquer clairement et à collaborer avec plusieurs disciplines
 Un souci du détail, un sens de l’ organisation et de la prise en charge de votre travail , ainsi qu’une capacité à respecter les priorités et les échéanciers de production
 Des expériences souhaitables, mais non obligatoires , en création d’effets pour un MOBA, un jeu multijoueur compétitif, un jeu d’action ou un jeu où la lisibilité est essentielle; en développement de jeux en exploitation, en améliorations après lancement ou en optimisation pour différents matériels; ou en livraison ou en soutien d’un jeu développé avec Unreal Engine
 Des connaissances complémentaires appréciées, mais non obligatoires , notamment une maîtrise avancée de Niagara, des nuanceurs Unreal, de l’intégration Blueprint, de la mesure des performances et des paramètres d’adaptation des effets aux capacités matérielles; une connaissance de Photoshop, Maya, 3ds Max, Blender ou Substance 3D; ou une compréhension des mathématiques vectorielles appliquées aux mouvements et aux effets procéduraux
 Ce qu’il faut nous envoyer 
 Votre CV mettant en valeur vos compétences, votre expérience pertinente, vos responsabilités et votre expertise technique
 Un portfolio ou une démo de vos meilleures réalisations en effets spéciaux temps réel, présentant votre processus de création, les outils utilisés, votre contribution et les contraintes de jouabilité ou de performance rencontrées, sous forme de fichiers joints ou d’un lien vers votre site Web personnel ou votre portfolio en ligne

AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter
 Organic Instagram & Facebook Reels | Direct Response Copywriting
 About Us
 Impact Clients is a fast-growing, 100% bootstrapped online education and software company. Through courses, coaching, and software, we help everyday people develop practical skills and build digital product businesses.
 We are launching an exciting new business division focused on AI avatars, viral health and wellness content, and supplement affiliate marketing.
 We are hiring a full-time AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter to join our internal team and help us build a portfolio of highly successful Instagram and Facebook accounts that generate millions of organic views and drive supplement sales.
 Your primary mission is simple: Research viral content, write exceptional short-form scripts, and turn organic views into supplement affiliate revenue.
 This is a hands-on creative position for someone who understands how to capture attention, write compelling health and wellness content, and turn social media engagement into measurable revenue.
 Company: Impact Clients
Website: https://go.impactclients.co/ Language: English
Availability: Full-Time (40 hours/week)
Time Zone: ET business-hour overlap preferred
Work Type: Full-Time, Remote
Industry: Health & Wellness, Supplements, AI Avatars, Affiliate Marketing, Direct Response
Expected Compensation: 2,000 - 3,000 USD/month
 Our Business Model
 We are building a new portfolio of organic Instagram and Facebook accounts focused on health, wellness, longevity, and supplement-related topics.
 Rather than using traditional human influencers, we use AI-generated avatars to create engaging, educational, and entertaining short-form videos.
 Here's how the business works:
 Research Viral Content: Identify high-performing health and wellness videos, trending topics, proven hooks, and compelling educational angles.
 Write Scripts: Turn research into original, attention-grabbing Instagram and Facebook Reel scripts designed to maximize retention, engagement, and sharing.
 Create AI Avatar Videos: Our production team uses AI avatar technology and video editing to bring your scripts to life.
 Drive Organic Traffic: Publish content across our Instagram and Facebook accounts to generate views, followers, and product interest.
 Generate Affiliate Revenue: Direct interested viewers toward relevant supplements sold through affiliate partners, including Amazon product pages, where purchases can generate commissions.
 Our goal is to build a repeatable, scalable content engine that consistently produces viral videos and generates meaningful affiliate revenue.
 You will be responsible for the research, hooks, storytelling, and scripts that power this entire operation.
 Example Accounts & Creative References
 Below are examples of Instagram accounts operating in the type of health and wellness content space we are entering.
 Please review these accounts before applying to understand the general content formats, topics, and creative styles we are looking to develop:
 Nutrition Is Greatness: https://www.instagram.com/nutrition.is.greatness/reels/ 
 Wellness Everyday Health: https://www.instagram.com/wellnesseverydayhealth/reels/ 
 Homestead Wellness Daily: https://www.instagram.com/homestead.wellness.daily/reels/ 
 Tyler Wellness Daily: https://www.instagram.com/tylerwellnessdaily/reels/ 
 Health Is Greatness: https://www.instagram.com/health.is.greatness/reels/ 
 Travis on Wellness: https://www.instagram.com/travisonwellness/reels/ 
 These accounts are provided as creative references for the type of organic health and wellness content we intend to produce.
 Your responsibility will be to research what makes content successful in this market and develop original scripts that can achieve comparable or better results.
 We are looking for someone who can identify proven viral patterns and turn them into original, engaging, revenue-generating content—not simply copy or rewrite another creator's videos.
 Responsibilities
 Research viral content daily: Discover high-performing Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other short-form videos in the health, wellness, longevity, and supplement markets.
 Write high-converting scripts: Develop original short-form video scripts designed to generate strong hooks, watch time, engagement, shares, and supplement affiliate sales.
 Develop compelling hooks: Write attention-grabbing openings that stop viewers from scrolling and make them want to watch the entire video.
 Master short-form storytelling: Structure scripts with compelling introductions, curiosity, educational value, and natural transitions into product-related calls to action.
 Research supplement products: Understand the supplements we promote, their ingredients, intended uses, consumer interests, and approved product positioning.
 Write product-focused content: Develop educational and promotional content around health topics that naturally connects to relevant supplement products.
 Optimize for revenue: Understand that our goal is not simply generating millions of views, but producing content that translates into clicks, qualified product interest, and affiliate commissions.
 Collaborate with AI video editors: Work closely with our AI avatar production team to ensure scripts translate into compelling final videos.
 Analyze performance: Review metrics including views, average watch time, engagement, clicks, and attributable sales to identify successful formats and improve future scripts.
 Build repeatable content systems: Organize research, winning hooks, proven angles, and creative templates to help our team consistently produce high-performing content at scale.
 Maintain compliance: Ensure health and supplement scripts avoid unsubstantiated medical claims, misleading representations, and prohibited claims while following applicable FTC guidance, affiliate disclosure rules, and platform policies.
 Continuously improve: Test different hooks, messaging angles, storytelling structures, and calls to action based on performance feedback.
 Must-Haves
 Strong copywriting ability, particularly for short-form videos, direct-response marketing, or social media content.
 Demonstrated ability to research viral content and understand why certain videos outperform others.
 Excellent understanding of Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and short-form content retention.
 Ability to write engaging scripts that communicate complex topics in simple, compelling language.
 Strong research skills and an ability to identify interesting health and wellness topics from credible sources.
 Understanding of persuasive writing, consumer psychology, curiosity-driven hooks, and effective calls to action.
 Ability to produce scripts consistently at high volume without sacrificing quality.
 Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and writing while maintaining originality and accuracy.
 Willingness to learn about supplements, affiliate marketing, and direct-response content monetization.
 Strong attention to detail, ability to follow feedback, and willingness to iterate based on performance.
 Excellent written English and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.
 Nice To Haves
 Experience writing viral Instagram or Facebook Reels that have generated 1M+ views.
 Experience writing direct-response copy specifically for supplements, health, wellness, nutrition, or longevity products.
 Proven track record writing social content that has generated measurable clicks, conversions, or affiliate revenue.
 Familiarity with AI avatar platforms, AI video generation, or faceless content production.
 Experience with supplement affiliate programs, Amazon Associates, or similar performance-based marketing models.
 Understanding of Facebook and Instagram algorithms, retention metrics, and organic content distribution.
 Experience writing comment-to-DM calls to action or using ManyChat-style automation workflows.
 Familiarity with supplement advertising compliance, health-related advertising restrictions, and affiliate disclosure standards.
 Experience creating high volumes of original content across multiple social media accounts.
 What Success Looks Like
 We are not hiring someone to simply write scripts and check boxes.
 We are hiring someone who is excited about the challenge of building a brand-new revenue division through viral content.
 Success in this position means:
 Consistently identifying promising viral content opportunities before they become oversaturated.
 Producing original scripts that achieve strong watch time, engagement, and organic reach.
 Developing repeatable winning formats that can be replicated across multiple accounts.
 Collaborating effectively with our AI avatar production team to maintain a consistent content pipeline.
 Creating content that generates meaningful affiliate clicks, supplement purchases, and attributable revenue.
 Continuously improving creative performance through research, testing, and iteration.
 Ultimately, we want a copywriter who thinks like both a creative strategist and a direct-response marketer.
 You should care just as much about whether a video generates sales as you do about whether it generates views.
 Our Core Values
 We believe that an exceptional company is built by exceptional people.
 Impact Clients has grown from zero to multiple eight figures without outside funding because our team operates with an entrepreneurial mindset, high standards, and a shared commitment to our customers.
 Our three core values define how we work:
 1. Client Success = Company Success
 Everything we do, from marketing and sales to coaching and fulfillment, exists to create the best possible outcomes for our customers.
 Client success always comes first.
 2. 1% Better Every Day
 We believe in constantly improving, both personally and professionally.
 Whether that's working out, reading, learning new skills, or sharing valuable ideas, our team takes personal growth seriously.
 We encourage continuous development—physically, mentally, and spiritually—and regularly share books, podcasts, lessons, and reflections with each other.
 3. FIO — Figure It Out
 We are an entrepreneurial, resourceful team of owners.
 We believe in hiring people who can take initiative, solve problems independently, and operate with very little micromanagement.
 Every team member is encouraged to treat their division like their own business, take full ownership of results, and find creative solutions to challenges.
 We believe that if you want to go fast, you go alone; if you want to go far, you go together. That's why we all choose as individuals to grow with this team because we are committed to the vision of building a billion-dollar enterprise-value organization, and having a ton of fun along the way.
 We work hard, set high standards, and genuinely enjoy building alongside talented, ambitious people.
 Benefits & Opportunity
 Competitive compensation: 2,000–3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and qualifications.
 Build a new division: Join at the ground floor of an exciting new AI avatar and supplement affiliate marketing business.
 Creative autonomy: Research viral content, test fresh angles, and develop your own creative approaches to generating organic growth.
 High-growth environment: Work inside an established, multiple-eight-figure company launching a new revenue channel.
 Work with AI technology: Collaborate with a team using AI avatars, video generation, and modern content production tools.
 Growth opportunities: Potential to expand into senior copywriting, creative strategy, or content leadership responsibilities as the division grows.
 Fully remote: Work remotely with a results-oriented team that values autonomy, ownership, and execution.
 Entrepreneurial culture: Join a team of ambitious people committed to personal growth, excellence, and building something meaningful together.
 How To Apply
 If you're passionate about viral content, direct-response copywriting, AI technology, and health and wellness, we'd love to hear from you.
 Please be prepared to share examples of your previous copywriting work, particularly short-form video scripts, along with any available performance metrics demonstrating results.
 We are looking for someone who wants to do more than write content.
 We want someone who can help us build a viral content engine that consistently generates millions of views and turns that attention into real, measurable revenue.
 Apply below to join our team.

Le rôle de la chef de boutique adjointe consiste à soutenir la chef de boutique dans la direction de l'exploitation de la boutique pour assurer un service à la clientèle exceptionnel et stimuler une croissance hautement rentable. La chef de boutique adjointe stimule les ventes et le rendement des ventes à l'heure par associée en soutenant la chef de boutique par la démonstration et l'enseignement des comportements de vente en place à La Senza, et ce, afin de créer une culture de vente à rendement élevé (CVRE) au sein de son équipe. De plus, elle atteint les objectifs de vente établis pour les boutiques. Elle vit nos valeurs et adopte des comportements qui représentent la marque.
 Rôles et responsabilités 
 • Soutenir la chef de boutique en créant un environnement de travail axé sur l'assurance d'un service à la clientèle exceptionnel et positif et adopter les comportements de vente de l'entreprise.
 • Attribuer les segments SVP (superviseure des ventes) et les quarts de travail à l'équipe de gestion des ventes.
 • S'intégrer à l'équipe de gestion des ventes en formant et en développant les associées en fonction des comportements de vente définis par l'entreprise.
 • Gérer et résoudre les problèmes liés aux relations avec la clientèle.
 • Appuyer le recrutement, l’embauche et le processus d’accueil pour assurer que la boutique se conforme aux directives de l’entreprise en matière de dotation en personnel.
 • Soutenir la gestion du cycle de vie professionnelle des associées aux ventes, y compris l'évaluation, la formation, la rétention, le développement de carrière, la planification de la relève et la reconnaissance.
 • Gérer et déléguer, au besoin, l'exécution de toutes les initiatives de l'entreprise.
 • Promouvoir et créer un environnement de travail positif et résoudre de façon efficace les problèmes liés aux relations entre associées.
 • Appuyer la gestion du budget de la main-d'œuvre, des taux salariaux ciblés et d'autres dépenses facultatives.
 • Soutenir le processus de l'inventaire physique et les autres stratégies de la boutique dans l'objectif de réduire les pertes.
 • Suivre les procédures d'exploitation universelles, y compris celles qui concernent les dommages, les transferts de marchandise et la conformité
 • Faire en sorte que les stratégies de marchandisage visuel sont accrocheuses et que les normes de présentation visuelle sont atteintes et maintenues, y compris l'identification et l'exécution des stratégies de démarquage.
 • Analyser les processus opérationnels et créer ou communiquer des plans d'action SMART qui optimisent les résultats et assurent une exécution efficace de l'ensemble des activités d'exploitation.
 • Soutenir la chef de boutique par la création de calendriers hebdomadaires et par la gestion du budget de la main-d'œuvre et d'autres dépenses facultatives.
 • S'assurer que les processus de réapprovisionnement sont efficaces et que la surface de vente est bien garnie de tous les modèles, couleurs et tailles, conformément aux directives du Guide de la marque.
 • Soutenir et renforcer les activités visant à assurer un environnement de travail sécuritaire
 • S'assurer que l'entretien ménager et l'entretien général sont correctement effectués.
 • Diriger avec professionnalisme en adoptant des comportements guidés par les valeurs de l’entreprise.

DO YOU WANT YOUR DESIGN WORK TO MAKE AN IMPACT AROUND THE WORLD?

Then Jobber might be the place for you. We’re looking for a Web Designer, Experimentation to join our Jobber Creative Studio department.

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=25.

The Team:

A great brand should be consistent, authentic, relevant, and everywhere - and that’s the goal of our Jobber Creative Studio (JSC). Through mediums like our website, trade shows, messaging, visual style, voice and tone, marketing campaigns, video, radio, etc. we want to tell the world who we are, what we do, and why we do it in a way that aligns our values with our customers' values. Branding is the magic that takes place when a person chooses a product outside of features and price, and our goal is to give people multiple reasons to choose Jobber.

The Role:

Reporting to the Art Director, Design, the Web Designer, Experimentation will turn experiment hypotheses into thoughtful, effective designs for Jobber’s website. You’ll collaborate with partners who develop those hypotheses, prioritize experiments, and analyze results, while focusing on translating those hypotheses into polished, testable designs.

This is an intermediate-level, hands-on web design and user experience role focused on independently executing well-defined experiments with support from senior design partners. You’ll design variants for A/B tests across landing pages and other marketing pages. These experiments will involve complete page concepts, individual sections, content hierarchy, calls to action, copy, and other elements of the web experience.

You’ll work closely with Jobber's CRO (conversion rate optimization), experimentation team, and Senior Web Designer to ensure your work aligns with experimentation goals and strategy, Jobber’s visual brand, and overall web direction. You’ll use our web design system to create experiences that feel consistent and cohesive, even as you explore meaningfully different creative approaches.

You’ll also collaborate closely with front-end developers to understand technical constraints, prepare implementation-ready designs, and make sure the final experience reflects the design intent.

We're excited about you because:

Your responsibilities : As the Director of Platform Engineering, you’ll: 
 Own the platform engineering team's mandate end-to-end: developer environment, CI/CD and deployment pipelines, test infrastructure and quality tooling, framework and dependency health, AI tooling for engineers, and the AI feature tooling stack

À propos de MaintainX

MaintainX est une plateforme d’exécution du travail de premier plan, conçue d’abord pour le mobile, à l’intention des équipes industrielles et de première ligne. Plus de 13 000 clients, dont Duracell, McDonald’s, Shell, DHL et Volvo, utilisent MaintainX pour réduire les arrêts imprévus et mieux gérer leurs opérations. La plateforme compte plus de 13,9 millions d’actifs gérés et 79,5 millions d’ordres de travail complétés, et nous bâtissons le plus vaste ensemble de données opérationnelles réelles de la catégorie.

En août 2026, MaintainX est devenue partie intégrante d’Autodesk et a rejoint Autodesk Operations Solutions, l’organisation qui unifie la plateforme d’exploitation d’Autodesk aux côtés de Tandem, FlexSim et Fusion Operations. La stratégie d’Autodesk consiste à réunir la conception, la fabrication et l’exploitation en un seul cycle de vie continu : concevoir un actif, le construire, l’exploiter, puis réinjecter ce que l’on apprend en l’exploitant dans la conception suivante. Autodesk avait la conception et la fabrication. L’exploitation est la phase qui révèle ce qui s’est réellement passé, et c’est la nôtre.

Contexte du poste

Ce poste fait partie de l’équipe Marketing de croissance client, au sein du programme de marketing par comptes ciblés (ABM) qui favorise l’expansion des sites chez nos clients existants des segments Grandes entreprises et Marché intermédiaire. Vous dirigerez les campagnes qui font connaître MaintainX à de nouveaux sites et à de nouveaux départements, afin que le pipeline d’expansion continue de croître à mesure que les cibles augmentent.

Le poste

Vous serez responsable de l’exécution de nos programmes ABM, afin que nous joignions un plus grand nombre de nos comptes ciblés avec des campagnes opportunes et pertinentes.

 - Piloter nos programmes ABM payants sur LinkedIn et en mode programmatique : constituer des audiences à partir de listes de comptes et de signaux, réallouer le budget et le contenu créatif selon l’engagement, et tester de nouveaux canaux à mesure que le budget augmente. Planifier et lancer des campagnes coordonnées (webinaires, événements, courriel, publipostage), synchronisées avec l’activité des comptes et les priorités des Ventes, afin que l’équipe des Ventes ait un point de contact pertinent lorsqu’un compte manifeste des signaux d’achat.

 - Configurer les campagnes dans nos outils ABM et de marketing, en contrôler la qualité, et maintenir des données de comptes et de contacts propres afin de joindre les bonnes personnes.

 - Rédiger les mandats pour les publicités et les pages d’atterrissage à l’intention de l’équipe de création, et tenir un calendrier de renouvellement pour qu’aucune campagne ne s’essouffle.

 - Produire des rapports sur les résultats des campagnes et proposer vos propres idées d’approches un-à-quelques et un-à-un, afin de cibler davantage de comptes à forte valeur.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec notre gestionnaire principal, ABM, qui définit la stratégie et la conception des signaux, et en partenariat avec les équipes des Ventes, du Succès client, des Événements et du Contenu. D’ici 6 à 12 mois, vous piloterez nos programmes payants de façon autonome, vous serez responsable de vos indicateurs de pipeline et vous aurez conçu vos propres approches par compte.

Votre profil

 - 4 ans et plus d’expérience en marketing B2B SaaS, avec une expérience concrète en publicité numérique payante, en ABM ou en génération de la demande

 - Expérience de gestion de campagnes payantes, idéalement sur LinkedIn et en mode programmatique, avec optimisation en fonction de la qualité du pipeline plutôt que du volume

 - Parcours démontré d’exécution de campagnes multicanaux de bout en bout, idéalement des campagnes ABM

 - Connaissance pratique d’Outreach (ou d’un outil semblable) et de Salesforce

 - Solides compétences en gestion de projet pour mener de front de nombreuses campagnes et échéances

 - Aisance à extraire des données de performance, à repérer des tendances et à en expliquer la signification

 - Esprit d’initiative et aisance avec l’ambiguïté : vous évoluez bien dans un environnement en forte croissance où les priorités changent

Atouts :

 - Expérience avec des outils d’ABM ou de veille commerciale (UserGems, ZoomInfo, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense)

 - Expérience du publipostage ou d’autres tactiques ABM hors ligne

 - Expérience dans le secteur des logiciels industriels ou d’exploitation

Ce que nous offrons

 - Un travail qui se voit dans le monde réel. Les comptes que vous ciblez exploitent des usines, des flottes et des installations, et quand notre logiciel fonctionne, leurs lignes de production restent en marche.

 - L’envergure d’Autodesk, la même mission. MaintainX fait partie d’Autodesk Operations Solutions (AOS), qui apporte la portée mondiale d’Autodesk au problème que nous cherchions déjà à résoudre.

 - Une place tôt dans l’aventure. Ce programme prend rapidement de l’ampleur, et les approches par compte que nous n’avons pas encore eu la capacité de mener, c’est à vous de les concevoir.

Pour en savoir plus sur les avantages sociaux, consultez benefits.autodesk.com http://benefits.autodesk.com.

Notre façon de travailler

Nous récompensons les résultats et nous promouvons rapidement les personnes qui livrent. Nous embauchons en fonction de ce que vous avez bâti, pas de votre titre. Vous bénéficiez de l’autonomie et de la confiance nécessaire pour l’exercer, et nous attendons de vous que vous proposiez des idées plutôt que d’attendre qu’on vous les demande. Les priorités changent dans une entreprise qui croît aussi vite, et nous le disons ouvertement.

L'opérateur de fabrication est chargé de fabriquer diverses formes posologiques et d'effectuer les différentes étapes du processus, telles que le pesage, la granulation, le mélange, la compression, l'encapsulation, l'enrobage et l'inspection de formes posologiques solides, semi-solides ou liquides, ou de formes posologiques liquides, selon sa spécialité professionnelle, tout en respectant divers critères dans différents domaines. 
Veuillez noter que nous ne pouvons embaucher que des personnes déjà basées au Canada et disposant de documents légaux et valides pour travailler au Canada. 
 Conditions :
 Salaire : 28.96 CA$/heure + prime de quart applicable (1,50 CAD/heure pour les quarts du soir et 2,50 CAD/heure pour les quarts de nuit)
 Emploi : Contrat initial de 6 mois avec forte probabilité de prolongation/renouvellement ou de conversion en CDI
 Quart de travail de nuit le week-end : vendredi 23 h à samedi 11 h, samedi 23 h à dimanche 11 h
 Il est obligatoire d'être basé au Canada et de posséder des documents valides (permis de séjour permanent ou permis de travail valide + numéro d'assurance sociale valide).
 Exigences :
 Expérience dans le domaine de la fabrication
 Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent.
 Maîtrise obligatoire du français
 Connaissance des BPF (un atout).
 Deux ans d'expérience dans le domaine pharmaceutique ou dans un domaine connexe (un atout).
 Aptitudes mécaniques et compétences informatiques.
 Tâches et responsabilités essentielles: 
 Nettoyage (différents types de nettoyage) de certaines pièces, de locaux (sols, murs, éviers, etc.), de conteneurs et de zones de travail.
 Démontage, nettoyage et remontage des équipements de production conformément aux procédures et aux BPF, en suivant les méthodes de travail standard établies le cas échéant.
 Planification du nettoyage afin d’optimiser les calendriers de production et l’utilisation des salles de nettoyage.
 Vérification de l'état des pièces et/ou des équipements en termes de propreté et d'état général, mise en service de certains équipements de production, et nettoyage des salles ou des sections.
 Évaluation de la qualité des équipements et des produits, évaluation de la qualité des équipements et des produits.
 Documentation adéquate (fiches de fabrication, registres, étiquettes de nettoyage, fiches de travail standard, etc.) conformément aux règles BPF et vérification de la documentation, et impression et/ou inspecter les comprimés ou les gélules conformément aux normes
 Effectuer la maintenance préventive (TPM), polir les poinçons
 Gestion des déchets (poubelles et/ou déchets pharmaceutiques), stockage des pièces
 Vérifier les matières premières, effectuer des tâches d'assainissement et réaliser certains rapprochements
 Maintenir un stock adéquat de certains produits et/ou équipements et/ou fournitures
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Alphanumeric is hiring a  Manufacturing Operator to work in Montreal, QC, with one of the biggest pharmaceutical manufacturing companies in the world.
 The manufacturing operator is responsible for manufacturing various dosage forms and performing the various stages of the processes, such as weighing, granulation, mixing, compression, encapsulation, coating, and inspection of solid, semi-solid, or liquid dosage forms or liquid dosage forms according to their professional specialty, while complying with various criteria in different areas.
 Please be aware that we can only hire people  already based in Canada  with fully legal and valid documentation to work in Canada. 
 Conditions : 
 Salary : 28.96 CAD/hour + applicable shift differential (1.50 CAD/hour for evening shifts and 2.50 CAD/hour for night shifts)
 Employment: 6-month contract with high potential for renewal or becoming FTE, benefits included
 Working Hours : Rotational shifts, including weekends and nights. Shifts will be allocated as per the team's needs Day shift: 7am-3pm
 Evening shift: 3pm-11pm
 Night shift: 11pm-7am
 Weekend night shift: Friday 11pm to Saturday 11am, Saturday 11pm to 11am Sunday
 Mandatory to be available to cover all shifts including nights, as per the company's needs 
 Mandatory to be based in Canada with valid documentation (PR or valid Work Permit + valid SIN)
 Requirements : 
 Experience in manufacturing
 High school diploma or equivalent
 Knowledge of GMP (an asset)
 Mechanical aptitude and computer skills
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Cleaning (different types of cleaning) of certain parts, rooms (floors, walls, sinks, etc.), containers, and work areas.
 Disassembly, cleaning, and assembly of production equipment according to procedures and GMPs, following established standard work methods where applicable.
 Planning of cleaning to optimize production schedules and the use of cleaning rooms.
 Checking the condition of parts and/or equipment for cleanliness and overall condition, starting up certain production equipment, and Clearing rooms or sections.
 Assessing the quality of equipment and products, evaluating the quality of equipment and products
 Adequate documentation (manufacturing sheets, registers, cleaning labels, standard work charts, etc.) in accordance with GMP rules and verification of documentation, and printing and/or inspecting tablets or capsules in accordance with standards
 Performing preventive maintenance (TPM), polishing of punches
 Waste management (trash cans and/or pharmaceutical waste), storage of parts
 Verifying raw materials, performing sanitation tasks, and performing certain reconciliations
 Maintaining an adequate inventory of certain products and/or equipment and/or supplies

Venture outside the ordinary - TMX Careers 
 Ready to be part of the action? 
 We are looking for an experienced Manager, Compensation , who thrives in complex, high-stakes environments and brings strong experience navigating the US market and US labour legislation — including FLSA regulations, state-level pay equity frameworks, and regional pay transparency mandates.
While physically based out of our Vancouver office, you will serve as a Compensation Manager, acting as the senior compensation consultant to assigned business units (which may span multiple regions) and a hands-on people leader within the Total Rewards team. You possess the professional maturity to influence senior leaders, navigate sensitive and consequential compensation decisions — including restructures, STIP design, leveling, and organizational design — and develop the people around you to deliver exceptional advisory work. You evolve programs to meet emerging business needs with a focus on measurable outcomes.
 This role reports to: Senior Manager, Compensation 
 This role is hybrid (2-3 days/week in the office) - based in Vancouver office 
 Key Accountabilities: 
 Leadership & People Development 
 Team Management: Provide direct leadership to Compensation Partner/ Analyst overseeing their professional development, performance management and daily deliverables. Set clear expectations, create accountability, and build a high-performing team culture.
 Capability Building: Act as a technical mentor and coach, elevating the team’s compensation advisory and analytical capabilities and ensuring the delivery of high quality, actionable insights to the business
 Workload Management: Manage team capacity across competing priorities and prioritize workstreams to ensure alignment with the broader HR strategy.
 Talent Development: Identify development opportunities for each team member, actively supporting their progression and building the bench strength of the compensation function.
 Business Partnering & Advisory 
 Senior Compensation Consulting: Serve as the senior compensation lead advisor for assigned business units, leading complex and sensitive matters including offer recommendations, job leveling, restructuring, and organizational design.
 Solution Design: Partner with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) and business leaders to co-create compensation solutions that balance business objectives, market competitiveness, and fiscal responsibility. Bring a commercially grounded perspective to every recommendation and ensure solutions are scalable and consistent with TMX's pay philosophy.
 Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Talent Acquisition, Finance, HR Technology, and business leaders to ensure the seamless execution of salary planning, bonus accruals, and financial forecasting across assigned portfolios.
 Compensation Literacy: Lead education sessions for employees, managers, and HRBPs to build compensation literacy and program engagement — and equip team to do the same.
 Market Intelligence & Compliance  
 Survey Strategy: Lead the annual market survey process for assigned functions, refreshing the survey strategy to ensure data sources remain relevant to TMX's evolving competitive landscape. Translate complex market data into clear, actionable insights that help leaders navigate the balance between market competitiveness and internal equity.
 Pay Equity & Compliance Ownership: Serve as TMX's subject matter expert for US compensation compliance — proactively monitoring Fair Labour Standards Act (FLSA) classifications, state-level pay equity requirements, and regional wage-and-hour laws. Provide strategic guidance to HR and Legal on required actions, timelines, and disclosures.
 Pay Transparency: Stay ahead of state and local pay transparency legislation, providing proactive guidance to Talent Acquisition and leadership on required disclosures and program adjustments.
 Projects and Programme Support 
 Portfolio Stewardship: Own the compensation outcomes for your entire regional and business unit portfolio — ensuring every decision within your scope reflects TMX's pay philosophy, is defensible under scrutiny, and is delivered with consistency across your team.
 Project Leadership: Independently lead regional and business unit-specific compensation projects from scoping through to delivery — such as job architecture reviews, pay structure updates, and compensation initiatives within assigned portfolios. Support enterprise-wide programs led by the Senior Manager, Compensation as required.
 Skills & Experience 
 Must-Haves: 
 Experience & People leadership: 7+ of progressive experience in compensation in a business partner or advisory capacity, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex compensation conversations with senior business leaders and HRBPs, including 2-3 years of experience directly managing or formally mentoring employees with a demonstrated ability to develop talent and build high-performing teams.
 Project Management: Proven track record of managing complex cross functional projects.
 Consulting Depth: Proven ability to advise senior leaders on complex and sensitive compensation matters — including restructuring, STIP design, job leveling, and organizational design — with sound independent judgment and commercial acumen.
 US Regulatory Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of US compensation regulations (including FLSA exemption testing, state-specific pay equity laws, and pay transparency requirements) along with experience benchmarking and designing structures for the US talent market. 
 Technical Knowledge: Deep expertise in total rewards principles, job evaluation methodologies, and compensation program design. Advanced proficiency in Workday Compensation, including incentive plan configuration and system enhancements.
 Analytical Rigor: Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality, accurate work under tight deadlines in a fast-moving environment — balancing precision with pace without sacrificing either.
 Adaptability: Proven ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-changing environment — maintaining rigor and sound judgment through ambiguity.
 Tools: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets (complex modeling) and project management frameworks.
 Education: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field.
 Nice-to-Haves: 
 System Expertise: Direct experience with Workday Advanced Compensation modules is an asset.
 Sales Compensation: Experience in the design and management of Sales incentive Plans
 Professional Designations: Completion of, or progress toward, CCP (Certified Compensation Professional) or CHRP/CHRL designation.
 Salary Range: 110,000/year - 130,000/year CAD

Location: At Reddit we continue to grow our teams with the best talent. We're completely remote friendly . 
 Team Description: 
 The Marketing Science team at Reddit leverages data to maximize the impact of Reddit’s own marketing investments. We serve as the engine behind our growth, using advanced experimentation, causal inference, and econometrics to understand what drives users to Reddit and what brings advertisers to our platform. We work at the intersection of brand building and performance marketing, ensuring every dollar spent is an investment in the long-term health of our ecosystem.
 Role Description: 
 Reddit is looking for a highly experienced Staff Data Scientist to lead the strategy and technical execution of our Marketing Intelligence efforts. In this role, you will be the primary architect of how we measure and optimize Reddit’s marketing spend. You will focus on two critical flywheels: B2B Marketing (acquiring and retaining advertisers) and B2C Growth (acquiring and engaging new Redditors).
 This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role where you will set the long-term strategic goals for Reddit’s marketing measurement, influencing senior leadership and defining how we value our brand and performance efforts.
 Responsibilities: 
 Set Long-Term Marketing Strategy: Define the 2–3 year technical roadmap for marketing measurement. Establish the "North Star" metrics and frameworks that determine how Reddit allocates hundreds of millions in marketing budget.
 Optimize Marketing ROI: Build and refine Media Mix Models (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) systems to mathematically quantify the incremental impact of marketing spend.
 Bridge B2B & B2C Growth: Design unified frameworks to optimize marketing aimed at both new advertisers (driving revenue) and new users (driving engagement), identifying synergies where brand awareness for one fuels growth for the other.
 Advance Causal Inference & Experimentation: Lead the design of complex "always-on" incrementality testing and geo-holdout experiments. Develop methodologies to measure the long-term "halo effect" of brand marketing on organic growth.
 Lead Through Influence: Collaborate deeply with Marketing, Growth, and Finance to translate complex data insights into actionable budget shifts. 
 Be the Technical Guide for the Team : Mentor junior scientists and set the technical bar for code quality and statistical rigor across the Marketing organization.
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Education: Advanced degree (Master’s or Ph.D.) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
 Experience: 
 For M.S. holders: 10+ years of industry experience in marketing science, growth data science, or econometrics.
 For Ph.D. holders: 6+ years of industry experience.
 Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the marketing ecosystem, including hands-on experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Incrementality Testing, and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) prediction.
 Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python or R and SQL. Experience building production-grade data pipelines and using machine learning for predictive modeling (e.g., churn prediction, lead scoring).
 Strategic Communication: Proven track record of influencing C-suite stakeholders and "translating" complex statistical concepts into business strategy.
 Adaptability: Experience working in fast-paced environments where you must navigate ambiguity and build frameworks from the ground up.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience with Bayesian structural time series or causal inference libraries.
 Previous experience in a high-growth marketplace or social media platform.
 A passion for the Reddit community and an understanding of our unique "Ads-as-Content" philosophy.
 Benefits: 
 Family Planning Support
 Gender-Affirming Care
 Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
 Comprehensive Medical Benefits & Health Care Spending Account
 Registered Retirement Savings Plan with matching contributions
 Income Replacement Programs
 Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
 Generous Paid Parental Leave

Rewind is a service that protects the critical data that powers businesses of all sizes. Our focus is on backing up data that lives in the cloud - in apps like Jira, GitHub, Confluence and Shopify. We are backed by Insight Partners, Inovia, Bessemer and Atlassian Ventures and are proud to be recognized as one of Canada's 50 fastest growing technology companies (2023 Deloitte Fast 50 https://www.deloitte.com/ca/en/about/press-room/deloitte-canada-announces-its-annual-technology-fast-50tm-program-winners.html). We invite you to read our startup story https://rewind.io/blog/why-we-started-rewind-backups/ to learn where we came from and where we’re going.

Read about our mission, story and values here https://rewind.com/about-us/.
To find out more about our perks, click here https://rewind.com/careers/#:~:text=Working%20at%20Rewind%20has%20its%20perks.
Some of our Blogs might help you get a better understanding of what we do here. You can find them all here https://rewind.com/blog/.

Thriving at Rewind:

We embrace the fast-paced, ever-changing nature of startup life. If you love working with speed, agility, and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. Here's what it takes to succeed with us:

 - Team-First Mentality: We put teamwork at the core of everything we do, believing that we are better when we are together. Success is shared, and when the team wins, we all win.

 - Performance-Driven Mindset: We are proactive, goal-oriented, and focused on delivering tangible, high-quality results. We go beyond meeting expectations - we aim to exceed them.

 - Flexible Work-Life Approach: We encourage balance and understand the need to recharge. While we stay agile for urgent needs, we make sure there's time to recover and enjoy life.

 - Customer Centricity: Our commitment to customers shapes everything we do. We listen, build relationships, and innovate - from our dedicated customer support team to our engineers, everyone at our company is focused on solving problems that matter most to our users.

 - Taking Initiative: We value ownership and proactive problem-solving. We encourage team members to think creatively, take ownership, and lead improvements. Your ideas and actions drive our success.

 - We Make Time for Fun: We work hard and make time to enjoy the journey. It’s not just about hitting milestones—it’s about making the experience rewarding along the way.

Rewind's mission is to help businesses protect their most valuable digital assets. As we

continue to scale, we are building the systems, leadership capabilities, and operating practices

that enable us to grow intentionally while maintaining our culture and values.

The Vice President, People, leads the design and execution of people strategies and systems that scale with the business. This role ensures our people practices, leadership capabilities, and operating model enable high performance, clear accountability, and sustained growth.



You are accountable for translating Rewind's values into durable systems, meaningful people

metrics, and a consistent operating cadence that supports how the company attracts, develops, and retains exceptional talent. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys building structure where it matters, challenging assumptions, and building culture.



What You'll Do

People Strategy & Culture Stewardship

 - Set and evolve Rewind's people strategy in support of company goals, growth plans, and long-term sustainability.

 - Act as a trusted advisor to the CEO and executive team on organizational health, talent risks, leadership effectiveness, and culture decisions.

 - Translate Rewind's values into operating principles, decision frameworks, and leader expectations.

 - Partner with leaders to maximize the effectiveness of distributed teams and leverage the benefits of hybrid work.

 - Develop and implement organizational health assessments and action plans that strengthen leadership effectiveness, employee engagement, and business performance.



People Operations & Execution

 - Own the operating model of the People team, including structure, capacity,prioritization, and delivery standards.

 - Design and implement people processes and operating rhythms that support effective planning, decision-making, and execution across the organization.

 - Align People team priorities with company objectives and business needs.

 - Establish clear forums and cadences, including talent reviews, leadership reviews, and retrospectives that connect people insights to business decisions.

 - Ensure leaders across the company have clarity on expectations, accountability, and follow-through as the company scales.



People Metrics & Organizational Insights

 - Define, track, and continuously improve People team KPIs, including engagement, retention, hiring effectiveness, and performance outcomes.

 - Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting that connect people metrics to business outcomes and provide actionable insights to leaders and the executive team.

 - Use people data and operational insights to inform discussions regarding organizational capacity, productivity, workforce planning, and organizational health.

 - Provide strategic recommendations and action plans based on trends and emerging risks.



Remote-First & Distributed Work

 - Own and evolve Rewind's remote and hybrid work strategy to ensure clarity, equity, and consistency across teams.

 - Design systems and norms that support strong performance, collaboration, and connection in a distributed environment.

 - Regularly assess what is working, what is not, and where adjustments are needed as the company grows.



Talent, Performance & Leadership

 - Oversee talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, learning and development, and succession planning.

 - Coach leaders to be strong people managers who set clear goals, provide meaningful feedback, and hold themselves accountable.

 - Support leadership development with a focus on execution, trust, and growth.

 - Ensure performance management practices are consistently applied, including timely feedback, development plans, and decisive action when expectations are not met.



Mergers, Acquisitions & Organizational Change

 - Lead HR due diligence activities for mergers, acquisitions, and strategic transactions.

 - Develop and execute people integration strategies, including organization design, change management, communications, and talent retention plans.

 - Partner with business leaders to ensure seamless organizational transitions and achievement of business objectives.



Employee Communications & Change Management

 - Develop and execute the company's employee communications strategy and annual communications plan.

 - Draft and oversee executive and organizational communications that support change initiatives, reinforce company values, and strengthen employee engagement.

 - Ensure consistent, transparent, and timely communication during periods of growth and transformation.


This role is open for candidate located in Ontario.



What You'll Bring

 - Proven experience in a senior people leadership role (VP or Senior Director level) in a scaling technology or SaaS organization that is PE or VC backed.

 - Demonstrated success building and scaling people functions and operating models.

 - Have built the People function, rather than inheriting a mature one

 - Experience in a Canadian or cross-border (Canada and US) workforce

 - Strong business acumen with the ability to connect people strategies to business outcomes.

 -  Demonstrated expertise in organizational design, change management, and organizational effectiveness.

 - Experience leading M&A due diligence and post-acquisition integration.

 - Experience supporting remote and distributed teams.

 - Exceptional communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills.

 - Sound judgment and the ability to navigate complex people and organizational situations.

 - A pragmatic, hands-on approach and the ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.



Compensation Philosophy
The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. 

In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly.

If your experience is closer to an earlier career stage, we may still consider your application. In that case, we would evaluate the role at a different level within our levelling framework.

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at Rewind.



Why join Rewind

At Rewind, you’ll help shape the future of data protection for thousands of businesses. We’re performance-driven, innovative, and not afraid to challenge what’s possible. You’ll join a team that values trust, accountability, and respect for people’s time — and encourages every employee to experiment, think critically, and grow.

We support innovation through experimentation — including smart use of AI tools — and believe the best ideas come from those who aren’t afraid to push boundaries.




How Rewind Will Support You
We know that enjoying the journey is just as important as reaching our goals. We work hard to create a positive, inclusive environment where fun and laughter are part of our everyday routine. We also offer a variety of benefits to support your success both at work and in your personal life which includes but is not limited to: 

 - Flexible work hours

 - Employee stock options

 - Health benefits

 - 3 weeks vacation

 - 7 life leave days

 - 2 Level Up days for professional development

 - 1 volunteer day

 - Summer Fridays and office closed during the holiday break in December

 - Paid parental leave

 - $2000/year wellness/home office allowance

 - $5000/year professional development allowance

Rewind is committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. We value how each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.



AI Usage

Our recruitment process may include the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools to help manage and review applications efficiently. These tools assist our team, but hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.

WHY HARVEY

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Workplace Project Manager, you'll take our workplace playbooks and standards and turn them into delivered projects and programs on the ground - office moves and openings, and global special projects like health & safety programming, design standards, emergency response planning, WVPPs, sustainability, and new tooling rollouts. This is a hands-on delivery role: you own scope, schedule, and budget for each project or program and drive it from kickoff to close.

Where the program sets the standard, your projects and programs bring it to life - on time, on budget, and to spec.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Global Special Projects

 - Project manage Workplace's global special projects: health & safety (H&S) programming, global design standards, global emergency response programming, Workplace Violence Prevention Plans (WVPPs), and sustainability programming across Harvey's office portfolio.

 - Partner with Security, HR, Legal, and regional Workplace leads to build and roll out emergency response plans and WVPPs that meet local regulatory requirements while staying consistent with Harvey's global standards.

 - Maintain and evolve global design standards (furniture, finishes, signage) so offices feel consistently "Harvey" as we scale into new markets.

 - Drive sustainability initiatives across offices - vendor and materials selection, energy and waste programs - and track progress against goals.

 - Own the global rollout of Workplace tooling and software - evaluating, piloting, and implementing platforms like desk booking, occupancy, and ticketing, and driving stakeholder training and adoption.

 - Own global and national vendor contracts (F&B, janitorial, plants, and similar categories) - procurement, negotiation, and the master vendor relationship - while regional workplace managers own the day-to-day relationship, performance, and feedback in their offices.

Global Playbook & Portfolio Management (Moves & Openings)

 - Build and maintain the FDOB checklist and playbook that regional workplace leads execute against for satellite moves, expansions, and new-office openings.

 - Own the portfolio-level calendar tracking when and where expansions and new offices are happening across the org, so Workplace can sequence and resource projects appropriately.

 - Step in to lead a move, opening, or buildout directly where a region doesn't yet have an established workplace manager, or where the existing regional team doesn't have the bandwidth - expect this to be a shrinking share of the role over time as regional coverage matures.

 - Coordinate with IT, Security, and AV to keep day-one readiness standards current in the playbook, so regional teams can deliver consistently without you running each project personally.

Program Management

 - Build and maintain project plans, schedules, and budgets across global programs and the FDOB playbook; track milestones, dependencies, and risks, and communicate status clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

 - Maintain the portfolio-level view across all in-flight and planned moves, openings, and buildouts, flagging sequencing and resourcing risks to leadership.

 - Manage vendor relationships tied to your global contracts and programs, holding them accountable to schedule and quality.

 - Report to the Global Workplace Operations Manager to ensure every program and playbook meets Harvey's workplace standards and sets regional teams up for smooth steady-state operations.

WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years in workplace operations, program management, or project management, with experience leading cross-functional programs such as health & safety, emergency preparedness, sustainability, or systems/tooling rollouts.

 - Strong program design and playbook-building instincts - you'd rather build a system and standard that others execute against well than run every project yourself.

 - Experience managing vendor and procurement relationships at a national or global scale.

 - Strong command of project management fundamentals - scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholder communication.

 - Experience partnering with (not necessarily owning) construction, real estate, or facilities teams on office moves or buildouts.

 - Excellent organizational and communication skills; you keep complex, fast-moving programs on track and everyone informed.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a hands-on, get-it-done approach.

 - Based in Toronto and able to work on-site at our Toronto office, with willingness to travel to other sites as projects require.

NICE TO HAVE 

 - Experience building or administering H&S programs, emergency response plans, or WVPPs.

 - Experience with sustainability program design or reporting.

 - Familiarity with project / workplace tools - e.g., Asana, Smartsheet, Envoy, OfficeSpace.

 - Experience building playbooks or programs that scale across a distributed, multi-region team.

 À PROPOS DU POSTE 
 Power Factors prend de l’ampleur en termes de complexité : davantage de produits, de plateformes, d’acheteurs sophistiqués, et des attentes croissantes quant aux capacités natives en IA dans notre suite de logiciels pour les énergies renouvelables. Dans ce contexte, l’absence d’une vision technique unique et imputable crée un risque réel : des schémas architecturaux divergents selon les secteurs verticaux, des approches incohérentes en matière d’investissement dans les plateformes d’IA et de données, et une dette technique qui s’accumule plus vite qu’elle ne peut être résorbée.
 Le rôle de directeur·trice de l’architecture logicielle existe pour combler cet écart. Il s’agit d’un poste de leadership technique pratique et hautement spécialisé, chargé de définir et d’appliquer les normes d’architecture d’entreprise à l’échelle de l’organisation Produits et Technologie de Power Factors (couvrant les secteurs Plateforme, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps et CAM/FSM/Ops produit), tout en concevant et en prototypant personnellement les problèmes les plus complexes auxquels l’organisation est confrontée, notamment en matière d’introduction de produits basés sur l’IA, d’acquisition de données IoT et d’évolutivité SaaS multitenant.
 Ce poste combine la portée stratégique d’un·e architecte d’entreprise et la crédibilité d’un·e bâtisseur·euse qui continue d’écrire du code, de réviser des demandes de tirage (pull requests) et d’être à l’aise en tant que personne la plus technique dans la salle.

 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 Power Factors is scaling in complexity — more products, more platforms, more sophisticated buyers, and rapidly rising expectations for AI-native capability across our renewable energy software suite. In that context, the absence of a single, accountable technical vision creates real risk: divergent architectural patterns across verticals, inconsistent approaches to AI and data platform investment, and technical debt that compounds faster than it can be paid down.
 The Head of Software Architecture exists to close that gap. This is a hands-on, deeply technical leadership role responsible for defining and enforcing enterprise architecture standards across Power Factors' Product & Technology organization — spanning Platform, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps, and CAM/FSM/Product Ops — while personally architecting and prototyping the hardest problems the organization faces, particularly around AI-based product introductions, IoT data acquisition, and multi-tenant SaaS scalability.
 This role combines the strategic scope of an enterprise architect with the credibility of a builder who still writes code, reviews pull requests, and is comfortable being the most technical person in the room.
 Purpose of the Role
 The Head of Software Architecture acts to define, evangelize, and enforce a coherent technical architecture strategy that allows Power Factors to scale product complexity without sacrificing reliability, security, or development velocity.
 •        Enterprise-wide architectural coherence: Technical decisions across verticals are grounded in shared architectural principles, not siloed team preferences.
 •        AI-native product development: New AI-based product capabilities are architected end-to-end — from data pipeline to model integration to user-facing experience — rather than bolted on.
 •        Development velocity multiplication: Engineering teams are equipped with modern AI-assisted development tooling and workflows that materially increase throughput.
 •        Deep technical credibility: Engineering leaders and individual contributors alike see this role as a working architect, not a slide-deck strategist.
 •        Domain-informed design: Architecture decisions reflect genuine understanding of renewable energy operations — SCADA, EMS, PPC, edge devices, and grid-facing data systems.
 This role acts as the connective tissue between the CPTO's organizational strategy and the day-to-day technical decisions made by vertical engineering teams.
 Core Responsibilities
 1. Enterprise Architecture & Complex System Design
 •        Define and maintain Power Factors' enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, and technical guardrails across all verticals
 •        Lead architectural reviews for major initiatives, ensuring consistency, scalability, and long-term maintainability
 •        Own the technical roadmap for cross-cutting platform capabilities (data platform, integration layer, identity, observability)
 •        Design for complex, high-availability systems where correctness, latency, and data integrity carry real operational and commercial consequences
 •        Partner with vertical leaders (SCADA, EMS, APM, Platform, CloudOps) to ensure local architecture decisions align with enterprise direction
 2. Technical Team Leadership
 •        Build and lead a distributed architecture function that operates as a trusted technical authority across Greece, Montreal, and other regions
 •        Mentor senior engineers and engineering leaders on architectural judgment, system design, and technical tradeoff analysis
 •        Establish and run architecture governance forums (design reviews, RFC processes, technical steering committees)
 •        Act as a technical escalation point for the highest-stakes design decisions across the organization
 3. AI-Based Product Architecture & Delivery
 •        Architect and personally help build end-to-end AI-based product capabilities — from data acquisition and model selection through deployment and monitoring
 •        Define Power Factors' architectural approach to LLM-based products, including use of Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval architectures, and agentic workflows
 •        Evaluate and select development LLMs and AI platforms appropriate for embedding into commercial products
 •        Own the technical bridge between REMI and other AI-native initiatives and the broader platform architecture
 •        Bring machine learning and data science expertise to bear on product decisions — model selection, feature engineering, data pipeline design, and MLOps practices
 4. Hands-On Development
 •        Write production code, prototype new architectural patterns, and directly contribute to the hardest technical problems facing the organization
 •        Lead by example on code quality, testing discipline, and engineering craftsmanship
 •        Stay close enough to the codebase to make credible, current architectural judgments rather than relying on secondhand reporting
 •        Build proof-of-concept implementations to de-risk major architectural bets before full team investment
 5. IoT, Edge, and Industrial Systems Architecture
 •        Architect scalable IoT data acquisition systems capable of ingesting, normalizing, and processing high-volume telemetry from distributed renewable energy assets
 •        Design architecture for edge devices and Power Plant Controllers (PPC), balancing on-site computation, latency constraints, and cloud connectivity
 •        Ensure architectural approaches account for grid code compliance, real-time control requirements, and the operational realities of SCADA and EMS environments
 •        Apply renewables and energy industry domain knowledge to inform data model, integration, and control system design decisions
 6. Cloud, SaaS, and Multi-Tenant Architecture
 •        Own cloud architecture strategy across GCP and/or AWS, including cost, resilience, and security posture
 •        Advance Power Factors' multi-tenant SaaS architecture to support scale, tenant isolation, and configurability without fragmenting the codebase
 •        Define architectural standards for mobile app development where products extend to field and operations use cases
 •        Evaluate build-vs-buy and platform consolidation decisions across the technology stack
 7. Engineering Productivity & AI-Enabled Development
 •        Identify, evaluate, and roll out AI development tools that enable a 3–4x productivity improvement across engineering teams
 •        Define best practices for AI-assisted coding, testing, and code review, balancing speed with quality and security
 •        Partner with engineering leadership to measure and report on productivity gains from AI tooling adoption
 Reporting & Operating Model
 Reporting Line
 •        Reports to: Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO)
 Embedded collaboration with:
 ◦        Vertical engineering leaders (Platform, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps, CAM/FSM/Product Ops)
 ◦        Product Management and Product Marketing on AI-based product introductions
 ◦        CloudOps and Security on infrastructure and compliance posture
 Operating Principles
 •        Architecture in service of the business, not architecture for its own sake
 •        Hands-on credibility over theoretical authority
 •        Pragmatic standardization — enough consistency to scale, not so much it stifles teams
 •        AI-first thinking applied responsibly, with attention to data quality, safety, and reliability
 Skills & Profile
 Required Experience
 •        15–20 years of progressive experience in software engineering, with significant time spent in architecture and technical leadership roles
 •        Enterprise Architecture & Complex System Design: demonstrated experience architecting large-scale, high-complexity systems with significant operational stakes
 •        Technical Team Leadership: proven ability to lead and mentor senior engineers and architects across distributed teams
 •        Trading/Transactional Systems: experience building high-throughput, high-integrity trading or transactional systems where correctness and performance are non-negotiable
 •        AI Product Delivery: track record architecting and shipping end-to-end AI-based product introductions, from concept to production launch
 •        Hands-On Development: an architect who still codes — genuinely enjoys building, not just designing
 •        IoT Data Acquisition: experience with systems that ingest and process high-volume telemetry from distributed physical assets
 •        Edge Devices & Power Plant Controllers (PPC): familiarity with edge computing architectures and industrial control systems
 •        Renewables / Energy Industry Experience: ideally direct experience in renewable energy or broader energy sector software (strongly preferred, not required)
 •        Machine Learning & Data Science: solid working knowledge sufficient to make informed architectural and platform decisions
 •        MCP & LLM-Based Products: hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol, development LLMs, and building LLM-based product features
 •        Cloud Platforms: deep experience with GCP and/or AWS at an architectural level
 •        AI Development Tooling: experience selecting and rolling out AI dev tools that meaningfully increase engineering team productivity
 •        SaaS & Multi-Tenant Architecture: advanced experience designing and scaling multi-tenant SaaS applications
 •        Mobile App Development: working knowledge of mobile architecture and delivery, sufficient to guide teams building mobile experiences
 Core Capabilities
 •        Strong systems thinking with the ability to zoom between enterprise strategy and line-level code
 •        Executive-level communication — able to translate architectural tradeoffs into business terms for the CPTO and executive team
 •        Comfortable operating with significant technical authority while remaining collaborative and low-ego
 •        Genuine enthusiasm for staying current with the fast-moving AI and LLM landscape
 Background Fit
 •        Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, VP of Engineering, or Chief Architect background
 •        Experience operating in a scaling, multi-product SaaS organization
 •        Comfortable being both the enterprise architecture authority and an individual contributor when the problem demands it
 Success Metrics (KPIs)
 •        Number of AI-based product capabilities architected and shipped to production per year
 •        Measured productivity gains (velocity, cycle time) attributable to AI development tooling rollout
 •        Reduction in cross-vertical architectural inconsistency and duplicated platform investment
 •        System reliability and performance metrics for enterprise-critical and transactional systems
 •        Adoption rate of architectural standards and reference designs across engineering teams
 •        Qualitative 360° feedback from engineering leaders on technical leadership effectiveness
 What This Role Is Not
 This role is not a purely strategic or advisory position removed from the codebase, and it is not a people-management role focused primarily on process and reporting. The Head of Software Architecture is expected to remain a credible, hands-on technical contributor throughout their tenure.
 The role also does not own product roadmap prioritization or commercial strategy — those remain with Product Management and the CPTO — but it directly shapes what is technically possible and how quickly it can be delivered.
